Initial release of drawio-architecture skill — combine .drawio XML authoring and direct MCP integration.

- Generate architecture, system, service, network, flowchart, cloud, and ER diagrams in native draw.io XML and open them directly in the draw.io editor via the official MCP server.
- Includes setup/config instructions for MCP server in popular chat agents and IDEs: Claude Desktop/Code, VS Code Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, and more.
- Supports key MCP tools for opening diagrams, searching the official shape library (cloud/brand/networking icons), and manipulating multi-page .drawio files.
- Provides guidance for both MCP-based delivery (for instant, in-browser editing) and local CLI export (PNG/SVG/PDF generation).
- Merges best practices and authoring rules from multiple proven sources for reliable, standards-compliant diagram creation.
